data.name: Agro Processors & Atmospheric Gases Ltd
data.description: The Company was incorporated in Pakistan on September 25, 1980 as a private limited company under Companies Act 2017. On February 11, 2021 the company changed its status from private company into a public company. The Company is mainly engaged in manufacturing and selling of vegetable ghee, cooking oil, allied items and substances.
